item.title: Redis Cluster Host View
item.description: Managing and expanding a Redis cluster can be confusing, especially when replicas are identified only by IP addresses. To simplify this, a browser-based tool was developed that visually maps masters and replicas, shows their locations, and tracks their status in real time. It generates the cluster topology as a Mermaid flowchart and runs entirely client-side without sending data externally.

item.title: Resume Template
item.description: Most of the resume template available online looked a little too fancy, cramped with a lot of information and less structured. I have tried to keep a formal and simple format with focus on make the information gathering linear and predictable.
